verdict.rationale: Publishing llms.txt or agent-oriented docs is a fair question for any product with a documentation site, so the axis applies to Blink Shell. The evidence shows no such docs. A probe of docs.blink.sh/llms.txt returned HTTP 404, and nothing else in the pack mentions agent-oriented documentation.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs
